label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Scheffler Leads FedEx St. Jude
items.text: Scottie Scheffler leads the FedEx St. Jude Championship at 13-under through the first hole, two shots ahead of Sam Burns and Sungjae Im at 11-under.

items.headline: Scheffler Nears PGA Earnings No. 1
items.text: Scottie Scheffler is set to pass Rory McIlroy and move to No. 2 on the PGA Tour’s all-time official money list, trailing Tiger Woods by $82,000.

items.headline: Rory McIlroy Eyes YouTube Golf Move
items.text: Rory McIlroy is expected to join LeBron James in entering the YouTube golf scene following a significant career announcement.
